title: The Athanor anatomy
description: Organs, public tools, native operations, modules, stores, services, and declared dependencies. Connections describe source, not observed runtime.

label: athanor chat [--room ROOM]
description: Terminal chat: opens the room WebSocket with the client bearer, subscribes, and sends athanor.chat.say per stdin line.

label: athanor doctor
description: Installation check mode, routed through manage.rs to the doctor report.

label: athanor install / update
description: Installs or upgrades a staged native release from --staging and --manifest, with optional database, house, and OMP integration flags.

label: athanor install-omp-adapter --source DIR
description: Verifies and activates an OMP adapter component release.

label: athanor keeper ROOM | --config FILE
description: Runs the omp_keeper loop for one room; ROOM resolves through the harness registry.

label: athanor launch-session --manifest FILE
description: Claims a one-use Host launch manifest, then runs the harness in the pane console and returns its exit code.

label: athanor rollback
description: Native rollback: undo backup, stop service, swap pointers, restore database, start and wait.

label: athanor rollback-omp-adapter [--release-id ID]
description: Moves the adapter pointer to a named or previous retained release.

label: athanor service
description: SCM entry point; hands the service name and entry function to the control dispatcher.

label: athanor start [--service]
description: Starts only missing parts: service via sc start, waits for PostgreSQL and NATS, spawns a detached Host. Keepers are not started.

label: athanor status
description: Prints one component matrix: service, PostgreSQL, NATS, Ollama, Host, and each registered keeper.

label: athanor uninstall / purge
description: Stops and removes the service, unregisters the loader, removes program tree; purge also removes data with --confirm-data-loss.

label: athanor.exe (the one exe)
description: One Windows binary. No argument runs the Host app; the first argument selects every other mode.

label: Windows service SolarisaelAthanor
description: athanor.exe service mode under SCM. Runs the supervisor that keeps PostgreSQL and NATS alive.

label: akasha binary (stdin JSONL)
